intent: A grid arena of breakable blocks where every player drops one bomb at a time; a bomb blows up after 3 s in a cross, breaking blocks and detonating every bomb it reaches, and each knockout in the chain is credited to whoever's bomb started it. Knocked-out players respawn after 3 s with 2 s protection; the most knockouts in a 180 s round wins, then 5 s of results and a fresh arena.
accept: Players move on a grid and drop a bomb with the action button, only one live bomb per player
A bomb explodes after 3 s as a cross that breaks blocks and sets off other bombs it reaches in a chain
A knockout caused by a chain reaction is scored for the owner of the bomb that started the chain
Knocked-out players respawn after 3 s at a free spot with 2 s of protection, and the 180 s round ends with 5 s results then a new arena
The before/after clip shows bombs, a visible fuse, cross-shaped blasts and a score display
